versions.changelog:
**Major upgrade: introduces dual operation modes (light scan & deep research) with multi-agent orchestration, improved robustness, and dynamic adaptation.**

- Adds two smart working modes: lightweight scan for recent papers and deep research for comprehensive studies, automatically selected based on user intent/time span.
- Overhauls workflow to use an orchestrator/main agent that directly performs search tasks for reliability, preventing output truncation issues.
- Sub-agents now handle intensive tasks (deep reading, multi-perspective analysis, writing, quality check) in parallel, each using isolated context for accuracy and output completeness.
- Introduces dynamic task piping and integrity checks: the main agent validates sub-agent outputs and fills in gaps when necessary.
- Enables flexible, user-adaptive configuration (focus areas, keywords), cross-platform tool compatibility, and robust data handling for end-to-end research report generation.
